|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may deploy a [Hoth] or [Episode I] device on a capital starship he is piloting from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. |errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Sil Unch (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Sil Unch (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 9 April 2025<ref name="ht-e3a0f34">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual25-Dark/large/silunch.gif</code> as published 9 April 2025: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e3a0f34bb4b751a00f718e03eb4c416ae9273765/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/silunch.gif holotable commit e3a0f34] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may deploy a [Hoth] or [Episode I] device on a capital starship he is piloting from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While piloting a [Trade Federation] capital starship, opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have a character with 'Trade Federation' in lore.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Sil Unch (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 10 August 2025: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, may deploy a [Hoth] or [Episode I] device on a capital starship he is piloting from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While piloting a [Trade Federation] capital starship, opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have a character with 'Trade Federation' in lore.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Sil Unch (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Sil Unch”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Sil Unch (V)]] (published 9 April 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Sil Unch]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
